newsitem.title: USA: Eastwind sees Q2 EPS, revs below views.
newsitem.headline: Eastwind sees Q2 EPS, revs below views.

text.p: Eastwind Group Inc said Friday it expects its revenues and earnings in the second quarter to fall short of expectations, leading to a net loss.

The company attributed the projection to disruptions and costs associated with the consolidation and competitive pricing pressure in commercial printing during the traditionally slow early summer period.
In addition, the company cited a deferral of revenues at its Polychem unit, which makes water treatment products, as a result of customers' changing delivery requirements on certain orders.
These revenues are expected to be realized during the next several quarters, Eastwind said.
A company spokesman was not immediately available for comment.

During the second quarter of 1997, results from its aerospace unit, Lavelle, and its Ivy unit, which makes home decorative products, are expected to be consistent with management's expectations, the company said.

Meanwhile, Eastwind, an investment holding company, said that its graphics communications unit, TEAM Graphics Inc, has completed the plant consolidation and restructuring of its three recent acquisitions.

The restructuring, which involved the physical consolidation of five operating facilities into three plants, downsizing of staff and divestiture of excess equipment, is to result in "substantial ongoing savings based on lower costs and improved efficiency," the company said in a statement.

"While we are disappointed with our second quarter results, nevertheless, the consolidation of the graphic communications business will result in lower overhead, more efficient use of personnel and new opportunities," Eastwind Chairman and Chief Executive Paul DeJuliis said in a statement.
